shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large rectangular stone slab
a small circle or disc set within the field
avian/wing motifs (feathered wing in A, bird figures in B)
horizontal banding dividing the field (register line in A, patterned band in B)
raised arms/limbs of a standing figure
justification: Both are tall rectangular stone panels worked in shallow relief and both include a small disc and profile creatures with wing/bird imagery, plus a dividing horizontal line or patterned band. But A is dominated by a single monumental, minutely detailed figure with plumage, curled hair and textured garment filling the whole field, while B is a stack of small, flat, schematic silhouetted animals in stacked registers — the compositional logic and the level of surface finish are quite different.
